theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_cyl_restriction_bounds
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ N k : ℕ, ∃ Φ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid N) k, (∀ (γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), Φ γ v = γ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ ∀ γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1), covectorEuclideanNorm (Φ γ) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) ∧ (∀ N k : ℕ, ∃ Ψ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid N) k, (∀ (γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), Ψ γ v = γ (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ ∀ γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) k, covectorEuclideanNorm (Ψ γ) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ)
